Natural Earth · U.S. Census Bureau 2026 TIGER/Line

Model note: Very coarse estimate: 0.025° cells (about 1.8–2.8 km) merge nearby roads and crossings. This is display resolution, not a measured accuracy bound.

Model note: Local travel is estimated at 25 km/h, including places without roads. Input access can follow retained road geometry at its assumed class speed after checked local access. Road travel charges retained geometry at assumed 55–105 km/h speeds with approximate transfers inside cells. Nearby roads and crossings merge within cells. No traffic, one-way roads, turn restrictions, terrain or actual access checks.

Model note: Natural Earth and U.S. Census Bureau 2026 TIGER/Line primary/secondary road linework form a modified coarse model, not an official Census product or a routable road inventory. International crossings and ferries are not modeled. Shore connections and added-road transfers require continuous generalized land. Input access allows up to 1 km of initial shore tolerance; unsupported origins remain isolated. Whole-cell shading can extend across borders or water. Small islands and water crossings can be inaccurate.
